fields.label: Dust Particle Concentration
fields.help: Enter the concentration of dust particles in the air compartments. Valid values are >= 0. The default value of 6.15E-08 is the value used for California residential sites by version 1.5 of the CalTOX model (see Table VI of CalEPA 1993 [Parameter Values and Ranges for CalTOX]). See the TRIM User Guide Appendix for full reference information.

fields.label: Density of Dust Particles
fields.help: Enter the density of dust particles in the air compartments. Valid values are >= 0. The default value of 1400 (1.4 g/cm3) is from Page 2 of Bidleman 1988 (Atmospheric processes). See the TRIM User Guide Appendix for full reference information.

fields.label: Density of Air
fields.help: Enter the density of air in the air compartments. Valid values are >= 0. The default value of 0.0012 (1.19E-03) is from Table B-1 of U.S. EPA 1997 (Mercury Study Report to Congress. Volume III: Fate and Transport of Mercury in the Environment). See the TRIM User Guide Appendix for full reference information.

fields.label: Fraction Organic Matter of Dust Particles
fields.help: Enter the fraction organic matter of dust particles in the air compartments. Valid values are 0 to 1. The default value of 0.2 (20%) is from page 1601 of Harner and Bidleman 1998 (Octanol-air partition coefficient for describing particle/gas partitioning of aromatic compounds in urban air). See the TRIM User Guide Appendix for full reference information.

fields.label: Height of Air Volume Elements
fields.help: Enter the default height of air volume elements. Valid values are >= 20. The default value of 226 is a health-protective choice from: approximately the 5th percentile of median hourly mixing heights, derived from data at 824 meteorological stations paired with upper-air stations across the United States from January 1–December 31, 2016. You may later override this value using a site-specific single value or a time series of mixing heights.
